tokens.name: void
tokens.usage: Page ground behind everything. Also the ink of the pattern squares cut into an `ink` block.

tokens.name: hull
tokens.usage: Panels, cards, table bodies, the top bar. The default surface for content.

tokens.name: hull-raised
tokens.usage: Something lifted off a panel: menus, popovers, a hovered row, table headers.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines: panel frames, table rules, dividers. Never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Edges that must be seen: input and secondary-button borders, unchecked boxes, upcoming steps. At least 3:1 on `hull` and `void` in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text, headings and figures on `void`, `hull` and `hull-raised`. Also the frame of the mark.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Labels, units, secondary lines and hints on `void`, `hull` and `hull-raised` (at least 6:1 in both themes).

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Disabled text and placeholder only. Below 4.5:1 on purpose: never for anything a pilot has to read.

tokens.name: signal
tokens.usage: The brand colour (Legion orange). The core of the mark, primary buttons, the current step, the active tab underline, the selected option. Used as text on `hull`/`void` it holds at least 4.5:1 on `void`, `hull` and `hull-raised` in both themes. Keep it to one or two things per screen.

tokens.name: signal-strong
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of anything filled with `signal`.

tokens.name: signal-tint
tokens.usage: Background of a selected table row or a picked option. `ink` stays the text colour on it.

tokens.name: on-signal
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a `signal` or `signal-strong` fill (6.7:1 hull, 5.9:1 chart).

tokens.name: scan
tokens.usage: The cold secondary: links inside prose, the second series in a chart, 'your' markers on maps. Never for buttons.

tokens.name: status-ok
tokens.usage: Good state: synced, running, profitable. Deliberately blue, not green, so it never depends on red/green vision. Always paired with a word or icon.

tokens.name: status-warn
tokens.usage: Needs attention soon: extractor ending, token expiring. Always paired with a word or icon.

tokens.name: status-danger
tokens.usage: Broken or lost: expired, needs login, loss-making. Always paired with a word or icon; it sits close to `signal` in lightness, so the word carries it.

tokens.name: on-status
tokens.usage: Text on a filled `status-ok`, `status-warn` or `status-danger` block.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset, on every interactive element.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: One per page, landing hero only. Sentence case.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Character names, option names, card titles.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: UPPERCASE. Readout labels, table headers, tags, nav tabs, module codes.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Restart the extractors on Tash-Murkon V before downtime.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: The one phrase in a paragraph that carries the action.

styles.name: figure-xl
styles.usage: The headline number of a readout.

styles.name: figure
styles.usage: Numbers in tables, metrics and deltas. Right-aligned in columns.

spacing.note: A 4px grid. Components use these steps exactly.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text gap, tag padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap inside a row of controls; tight stacks.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Padding of compact rows and table cells.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Panel padding on phones; button side padding; grid gutter.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Panel padding on desktop; gap between panels.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between sections inside a page.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Between major page bands; above the footer.

radius.note: AstraCore is square. Corners are cut (see chamfer), not rounded.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Everything: buttons, inputs, panels, images, tags.

tokens.name: radius-dot
tokens.usage: Only the 8px live-status dot. Nothing else is round.

chamfer.note: The signature 45-degree cut, taken from the mark. Cut the top-right and bottom-left corners only.

tokens.name: chamfer-sm
tokens.usage: Readouts, option cards, small panels.

tokens.name: chamfer-md
tokens.usage: Panels and module tiles.

tokens.name: chamfer-lg
tokens.usage: Hero blocks, the cover, large imagery frames.

tokens.name: stroke-hair
tokens.usage: Every frame, rule and control border.

tokens.name: stroke-bar
tokens.usage: Active tab underline, progress tracks, step connectors.

tokens.name: stroke-focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring width; offset it by 2px.

tokens.name: container
tokens.usage: Max content width.

tokens.name: rail
tokens.usage: Fixed left control rail of planner-style pages.

tokens.name: control-h
tokens.usage: Height of buttons, inputs and selects.

tokens.name: bar-h
tokens.usage: Height of the top bar.

tokens.name: shadow-lift
tokens.usage: Only floating layers: menus, popovers, dialogs. Panels on the page get a hairline, never a shadow.
